basic_details.short_information: UPSC Recruitment 2026 is being conducted through direct recruitment by selection, as announced by the Union Public Service Commission, Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi-110069. Candidates can apply online for the following posts. Register for Job Alerts

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), based on the pay level applicable to the post applied for.

how_to_apply: Visit the official UPSC online application portal at https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/.
Locate Indicative Advertisement No. 10/2026 and select the post you wish to apply for.
Read the detailed advertisement and eligibility instructions on upsc.gov.in before proceeding.
Fill in the online application form with the required details.
Submit the application before the applicable last date - 28th August 2026, or 4th September 2026 for posts under Administration of UT of Ladakh.

content_sections.text: UPSC Recruitment 2026 is being conducted through direct recruitment by selection, as announced by the Union Public Service Commission, Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi-110069. Candidates can apply online for the following posts. Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 34 vacancies are available across 7 posts under UPSC Recruitment 2026. Category-wise distribution and pay scale for each post are given below. Of the nine vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Electronics), one is reserved for candidates belonging to the category of persons with benchmark disability (PwBD). Similarly, of the eleven vacancies for Research Officer, one is reserved for PwBD candidates.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is further relaxable by up to 10 years for PwBD candidates in respect of vacancies identified as suitable and/or reserved for them. The closing date for submission of the online application is the crucial date for determining age. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.age_limit: 35 years for UR, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST
35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), based on the pay level applicable to the post applied for.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for UPSC Recruitment 2026 can be submitted only in online mode through the official portal https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ . No other mode of application has been mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Important Notes
content_sections.text: Candidates looking for engineering opportunities can also explore the latest Engineering Government Jobs and Assistant Engineer Government Jobs available across India. Applicants with qualifications in research and science can check the latest Research Officer Jobs and Government Research Jobs. Those looking for government opportunities in different departments can also explore the latest Central Government Jobs and UPSC Recruitment 2026 notifications. Candidates interested in vacancies in horticulture, agriculture, and environmental fields can browse more Agriculture Government Jobs, Horticulture Jobs, and Soil Conservation Jobs matching their qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Union Public Service Commission under Indicative Advertisement No. 10/2026, inviting online applications for direct recruitment by selection to 7 posts across various ministries and the Administration of UT of Ladakh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available across 7 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 28th August 2026 for posts other than those under the Administration of UT of Ladakh, and 4th September 2026 for posts under the Administration of UT of Ladakh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The educational qualification is not specified in the provided notification. Candidates should check the detailed advertisement on the Commission's website.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post and category, ranging from 30 years to 40 years, with PwBD candidates eligible for further relaxation of up to 10 years for identified vacancies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ from 8th August 2026 up to the applicable last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through direct recruitment by selection. Further stage-wise details are not specified in the provided notification.
